seo.title: Pension portfolio check
seo.description: A pension portfolio check through Israel's pension clearinghouse: all your funds, the management fees you actually pay and your insurance cover — in one place, reviewed by a planner.
page.title: Pension portfolio check
page.intro: All your pension, provident and study funds — across every company, in one place: how much has built up, what you actually pay in management fees, and what cover you have. Dorit goes through the figures, and then you meet to talk about what is worth doing with them.
step1.title: Leave your details
step1.text: Name and phone — and an email if you want the personal link right away.
step2.title: Hand over a clearinghouse code
step2.text: The personal link explains it step by step: you generate a power-of-attorney code on the clearinghouse's site and hand it over, together with your ID number.
step3.title: Dorit reviews the portfolio
step3.text: Every fund, the fees and the cover — then you meet to talk about what is worth doing.

form.privacy: Your details are used only to get back to you and for the check.
